edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, seeding privileged state from caller input.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer(msg.sender, to, tokens).
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with caller-controlled key.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using caller as spender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner to change newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier gates the owner-only token sweep.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before moving ownership.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
Token constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Token constructor sets the name state variable.
Token constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Token constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Token constructor credits balances of the hardcoded deployer address.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
totalSupply reads _totalSupply from storage.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed nested mapping before calling out.
transferAnyERC20Token sends swept tokens to the owner address.
transfer delegates the sender debit to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to SafeMath.safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance debits to SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient credit to SafeMath.safeAdd.
totalSupply performs a raw subtraction of balances[address(0)] without SafeMath guarding underflow.
approveAndCall executes an arbitrary external receiveApproval call while state was just written.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external ERC20 transfer call to an owner-supplied address.
The spender contract's receiveApproval callback can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions.
The tokenAddress contract can call back into transferAnyERC20Token during the sweep.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval call.
The user-supplied spender parameter is the target contract of the external call.
Arbitrary user data is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
The owner-supplied tokenAddress parameter is the target contract of the external call.
Parameter a is an operand of safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of safeAdd.
safeAdd assigns the sum into its return variable c.
Parameter a is the minuend of safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend of safeSub.
safeSub assigns the difference into its return variable c.
Parameter a is a factor of safeMul.
Parameter b is a factor of safeMul.
safeMul assigns the product into its return variable c.
Parameter a is the dividend of safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor of safeDiv.
safeDiv assigns the quotient into its return variable c.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf writes the looked-up value into its return variable balance.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount debited and credited in transfer.
transfer sets its return variable success to true.
spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve.
approve sets its return variable success to true.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
transferFrom sets its return variable success to true.
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowance lookup.
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowance lookup.
allowance writes the looked-up value into its return variable remaining.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the callback target in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is the allowance value and callback amount in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded bytecode during approveAndCall.
approveAndCall sets its return variable success to true.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external token contract to sweep.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded in the sweep.
transferAnyERC20Token returns the result of the external transfer call.
